profiles.guidance: Select host CPU features when native compilation is safe; avoid generic targets for production builds.
Benchmark compile-tune-compile loops and persist validated tuning specs per hardware/workload.
Bound workers by available concurrency and workload type; prefer measured parallel plans over fixed maximums.
Prefer zero-copy buffers and asynchronous I/O where the platform backend supports them.
Use bounded sampling and structured traces so diagnostics do not dominate workload execution.
Publish SBOM artifacts and continuously inspect dependencies before accepting updates.
Use an embedded analytical provider such as DuckDB through an adapter boundary for local analytics.
